study: Garet et al. 2016, Content-Intensive Teacher PD (Intel Math) (NCEE 2016-4010)
delivery_evidence: Three in-person components: Intel Math 80-hr summer workshop, five 2-hr in-person Mathematics Learning Community meetings, and Video Feedback Cycles delivered as individual face-to-face feedback sessions by district-based facilitators (ch.3, p.~? 'District-based facilitators delivered three individual feedback sessions per study teacher'). Video is of the teacher's own lesson, not online delivery.
test_alignment_evidence: Two included outcomes: a study-administered NWEA assessment 'aligned with the content of the PD' (proximal/aligned) AND a broad state math assessment (distal/independent) (Exhibit 4.4, p.40; Exhibit D.6).
curriculum_evidence: PD built teachers' mathematical content knowledge (Intel Math) plus practice supports; no new grade-4 student curriculum was adopted—teachers used their existing math curriculum (control = business-as-usual).
outcome_timing_evidence: Both effect sizes measured Spring 2014, the end of the single treatment year (Exhibit 4.4, p.40; Exhibit D.6).
